review.description: Reconcile four focused work tabs, direct item conversations, first-message explicit Start/recovery and retirement of the intermediate item page. Priority remains left of the title and identifiers remain source links. Separate settings stays independent. Read connection recovery now clears only the relevant read feedback, preserves action failures/drafts, retries initial handshakes with fresh SDK instances and never replays mutations. Settings model responses exclude unrelated item/run/attention content. GitHub anchors remain native href siblings while normal activation uses the host bridge, preserving unread/New and primary selection. Manager.Message now restores inactive sessions with one submitted continuation turn and preserves the existing MCP interface.
